engine: r1864's apartment-type gallery — a CAROUSEL where each slide is a DUAL-IMAGE SPLIT (left interior + right city-view, side by side) with a STAT-ROW OVERLAID across the bottom (площадь / спальни / высота) + a type TITLE overlaid at top; round ‹ › arrows (+ a 'NN / N' counter) swap the WHOLE pair. On enter the active split clip-reveals from the CENTRE SEAM outward + the stat-row rises. The 'compare the type — inside vs the view' chapter. Harvested from D_r1864 (r18641 /comfort + apartment-types: a split panel beside a full interior, ‹ › 2/2).

measured_teardown.move: TWO motions. A) ENTER (scroll-into-view scrub, p 0..1, PURE set(p)): the active split's two images clip-reveal from the CENTRE seam outward (left img inset-right 100%->0, right img inset-left 100%->0) over 0..0.6; the type title fade + translateY 24->0 over 0.25..0.55; the stat-row stats each fade + translateY 20->0 staggered over 0.45..1.0. ease power3.out. B) SWAP (‹ › arrows / dots / drag): cross-fade + slight scale (1.03->1) between split pairs (eased, not scroll); title + stat-row re-render to the new type and animate in; the 'NN / N' counter updates; finite unless loop:true (default loop).
measured_teardown.cited: r18641 /comfort + apartment types: a split with a stat-headline + body + a 'NN / N' counter + ‹ arrow beside a full interior, and side-by-side interior/view images with площадь / спальни / высота readouts. Distinct from the single full-bleed slide of fullscreen-media-carousel.

start.what: ScrollTrigger start for the enter reveal.

loop.what: wrap at the ends (true) or clamp (false).

once.what: play the enter once or reset on leave-back.

manageLenis.what: own a Lenis instance if present; false when a shared page Lenis drives scroll.

entry: DualImageSplitStat.create(target, opts) -> { trigger, lenis, set(p), play(), next(), prev(), go(i), refresh(), destroy }. target = .dss-stage > .dss-viewport ( .dss-slide[data-title][data-stats] x N, each = .dss-split( .dss-img.dss-img--l + .dss-img.dss-img--r ) ) + .dss-meta( .dss-title + .dss-stats ) + .dss-nav( .dss-prev + .dss-counter + .dss-next ). data-stats = 'num|label ; num|label ; ...'. set(p 0..1) is a PURE scrub of the ENTER; next/prev/go swap pairs.
law: clip-path(inset) + transform + opacity only; GPU; NO mix-blend; NO WebGL. The title + stat-row are OVERLAID (a bottom scrim guarantees legibility). reduced-motion or <=820px -> shown (first split shown, split stacks to rows, stats visible). owns_pin false (a scroll-into-view reveal + a manual pair carousel). GSAP+ScrollTrigger required for the scroll reveal; set(p) + next/prev standalone.
gate_mode: scroll-into-view reveal (not pinned) + a manual pair carousel. Verify: on enter the two images open from the centre seam outward + the type title + stat-row rise; clicking ‹ › swaps the WHOLE pair (cross-fade, title + stat-row re-render, counter NN/N updates, wraps). Smoothness via the scroll path. NOTE: full-height split — to screenshot, scroll so the stage fills the frame.
proven: lab: 4 type-slides (Историческая / Частная / С террасами / Пентхаусы), each a dual-image split (interior + view) with an overlaid type title + a 3-stat row (real r1864 numerals: 105-165 / 1-2 / 3,4-4 ... 623-987 / 5-7 / 558-664). ENTER curve measured live (p / left-img-inset-right / right-img-inset-left / title / stat1 / statN): 0 / 100% / 100% / 0 / 0 / 0 -> 0.30 / 12.5% / 12.5% / 0.42 / 0 / 0 -> 0.60 / 0% / 0% / 1 / 0.76 / 0 -> 0.80 / 0% / 0% / 1 / 1 / 0.81 -> 1 / 0% / 0% / 1 / 1 / 1. SWAP: ‹ › 01/04 -> 02/04, title 'Историческая' -> 'Частная', stat-row re-renders (#3 stats); WRAP: prev 02->01, prev again -> 04/04 (loop). Zero console errors. Smoothness probe (4x CPU throttle, scroll-enter + 2 swaps): 304 frames, 1.32% long frames -> PASS. Photos = quadro renders (honest demo assets; engine takes any photos). Relative: fullscreen-media-carousel (ONE full-bleed slide) — this is the DUAL-IMAGE SPLIT-PAIR carousel w/ overlaid stat-row; also distinct from center-seam-split (seam-reveal, not a carousel). Serif = Playfair Display (Didot/Bodoni class).
